About Bridge Realty

Brokerage founded in 2006, Bridge Realty is the largest family-owned real estate company in the Twin Cities. We specialize in residential and commercial properties, including single-family homes, condos, multi-family investments, and new construction. Client satisfaction is our top priority, and we work with buyers and sellers across all price ranges. As Minnesota’s first 100% commission brokerage, we’re backed by a strong culture of honesty, excellence, integrity, and open communication. By connecting sellers and buyers and supporting the professional growth of our brokers, we help our community thrive.
